visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing navy blue medical scrubs, stands in a brightly lit clinic hallway. She holds a white card with black text while smiling broadly at the camera. Animated pink blush marks are superimposed on her cheeks. (2) She quickly flips the card to reveal another one with different text. A white heart animation pops up briefly in the center of the frame as she continues to smile and look directly at the viewer. (3) The screen splits into three horizontal sections. The top shows a close-up of a patient's face receiving a skin treatment with a medical device. The middle shows a needle injection near an eyebrow. The bottom shows another facial treatment. Stylized neon text and sparkles appear over each. (4) A woman with short hair, wearing round glasses and a brown striped shirt, sits in an office. She waves her right hand at the camera with a cheerful expression. Animated red hearts float above her head. (5) A clean white screen displays the 'DRX' logo, social media handles, a phone number, and two addresses.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, rhythmic acoustic pop track featuring bright guitar strumming and a crisp drum beat. The atmosphere is energetic and positive. (2) A subtle 'pop' sound effect is heard as the visual cards are switched, maintaining synchronization with the on-screen action. (3) A series of light 'sparkle' sound effects accompany the appearance of medical treatment labels, adding a sense of quality and high production value. (4) The BGM continues steadily as the scene shifts to the waving woman, providing a cheerful backdrop to her gesture. (5) The music concludes with a short, soft melodic resolution as the final brand contact card appears, leaving a professional and polished acoustic impression.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote professional dermatological treatments as the ideal Valentine's Day gift. It starts with a humorous hook challenging traditional gift ideas, then transitions to showing specific high-end procedures (Thermage, Juvelook, Sofwave) at the DRX clinic, concluding with a friendly greeting and contact information for potential clients.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses holiday-themed marketing to position medical aesthetics as a lifestyle gift. The combination of relatable social-media-style presentation with professional split-screen treatment footage builds both trust and interest.
